senses.zh_definition: 米拉娜：专有名称，可指《Dota 2》及动画《DOTA：龙之血》中的女性角色；未核实其具有马来语普通词义。
senses.en_definition: A proper name, notably that of a female character in Dota 2 and DOTA: Dragon’s Blood; not verified as a Malay common word.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas, antaranya nama watak wanita dalam Dota 2 dan DOTA: Dragon’s Blood; makna sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum dapat disahkan. Huraian ini bukan takrif rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 正文中须大写为 Mirana。原始资料没有 DBP 释义，检索也未确认普通词条，因此不能标为已获官方确认的马来语词。角色身份可由 [Netflix 官方介绍](https://media.netflix.com/en/only-on-netflix/80994336)确认；但不能据此断定输入词频中的所有实例均指该角色。以下搭配与例句为教学拟写，搭配频率未经语料核实。

etymology.historical_story: Mirana illustrates how fictional names can enter multilingual texts without becoming ordinary vocabulary. Netflix identifies Princess Mirana in its official synopsis for DOTA: Dragon’s Blood. That establishes a character reference, but does not establish a Malay lexical meaning or the name’s linguistic origin. No historical derivation is asserted here. Source: [Netflix Media Center](https://media.netflix.com/en/only-on-netflix/80994336).
